user.title: Add Specialized Turbo Bike
user.description: Select your Specialized Turbo bike from the discovered devices.

data_description.address: Select the Specialized Turbo bike you want to add.
data_description.key_source: Use your Specialized account to retrieve the bike key automatically, or enter a wrapped key manually.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Discovered Specialized Turbo Bike
bluetooth_confirm.description: A Specialized Turbo bike was found at {address} ({name}). Pairing prompts are handled by the active Bluetooth backend.

data_description.key_source: Use your Specialized account to retrieve the bike key automatically, or enter a wrapped key manually.

account.title: Sign in to Specialized
account.description: Your password is used only to retrieve this bike's encryption key. Home Assistant stores the per-bike wrapped key, not your password or account tokens.

key_source.title: Choose encryption key source
key_source.description: Use your Specialized account to retrieve the bike key automatically, or enter a wrapped key manually.

manual_key.title: Enter wrapped bike key
manual_key.description: Enter the 64-character wrapped key returned by the Specialized keystore service.

reauth_confirm.title: Encryption key required
reauth_confirm.description: This bike requires an encryption key. Choose how to retrieve it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Specialized Turbo
reconfigure.description: Replace the encryption key for your Specialized Turbo bike.

error.cannot_connect: Could not complete the bike connection. Make sure it is powered on, nearby, and paired.
error.invalid_auth: The Specialized account credentials were rejected.
error.key_unavailable: The Specialized encryption key could not be retrieved.

abort.no_devices_found: No Specialized Turbo bikes found. Make sure the bike is powered on and Bluetooth is enabled.
abort.not_encrypted: This bike has no stored encryption key to reconfigure.
